headline: US Strikes Iranian Island Following Signals of Potential Agreement
summary: According to the Wall Street Journal, Washington conducted limited military operations against an Iranian island without public announcements to avoid escalating the conflict, following signals from Trump regarding a potential deal.
why: Geopolitical tensions in the Middle East significantly impact global energy supplies, shipping routes, and risk sentiment across financial markets.

impacts.name: Brent crude
impacts.why: Middle East military escalations raise concerns over potential crude oil supply disruptions.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Military actions involving major geopolitical actors in the Middle East heighten supply disruption risks in global oil markets, driving safe-haven demand and commodity price volatility.
